content.title: Is 'SNL' New Tonight? Here's What to Know About the Sixteenth Episode of Season 51
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Saturday Night Live is new on April 4Jack Black is serving as host and Jack White is performing as musical guestSNL airs at 11:30 p.m. EST / 8:30 p.m. PST on NBC Saturday Night Live is new tonight! After the late-night comedy sketch series saw Harry Styles perform double duty as host and musical guest on March 14, SNL is back for another episode on Saturday, April 4. SNL went through a cast shakeup following its milestone 50th season. Devon Walker, Emil Wakim, Michael Longfellow, Heidi Gardner and Ego Nwodim all announced their exits, and the television series added some fresh faces to the mix for season 51, with Tommy Brennan, Jeremy Culhane, Ben Marshall, Kam Patterson and Veronika Slowikowska all joining as featured players, alongside returnees Ashley Padilla and Jane Wickline. That group joined returning cast members Michael Che, Mikey Day, Andrew Dismukes, Chloe Fineman, Marcello Hernández, James Austin Johnson, Colin Jost, Sarah Sherman, Kenan Thompson. Bowen Yang also rejoined, but he later exited SNL during the Dec. 13 episode. Here, find everything you need to know about episode sixteen of SNL's season 51. 'SNL's Studio 8H. NBCU Photo Bank/NBCUniversal via Getty Is there a new episode of SNL tonight? Yes, SNL is new on Saturday, April 4. It is the sixteenth episode of season 51. Who is host and who is musical guest? Jack Black is serving as host and Jack White is performing as musical guest. The episode will mark the actor's fifth time hosting, earning him access to SNL's elusive Five-Timers Club. White, meanwhile, will mark his sixth time appearing as a musical guest. The PEOPLE Puzzler crossword is here! How quickly can you solve it? Play now! Related Stories What time does SNL air? SNL airs at 11:30 p.m. EST / 8:30 p.m. PST. Where can I watch SNL? New episodes of SNL air live on NBC and Peacock on Saturdays, and they are later available to stream. Who will host and perform on SNL next? Colman Domingo will serve as host and Anitta will perform as the musical guest when SNL returns on April 11. Saturday Night Live airs weekends on NBC.
